name: Persistent cart supports add update and remove
description: Verify the anonymous cart is backed by the API and persists through reload while quantities and totals stay correct.

planSteps.description: Navigate to the home page, wait for products, and add Everyday Canvas Tote to the cart.
Verify the cart header shows 1 item and a success notification appears.
Reload the page and open the cart.
Verify Everyday Canvas Tote still exists in the cart with quantity 1 and subtotal Rp189.000.
Verify quantity is 2, item count is 2, and subtotal is Rp378.000.
Remove Everyday Canvas Tote from the cart.
Verify the empty-cart state is displayed.
